notes.title: 0.13 Version Update
notes.content:
1、 Fixed numerous bugs.

2、 Added Korean and Russian translations (translations still need optimization).

New content and other bug fixes will be implemented in next month's update.

notes.title: Version 0.12 Update:
notes.content:
1.Bug Fixes: Fixed issues with keybindings and technology tree values.
2.Enhanced Features: Improved breast physics simulation (further improvements to come).
3.Visual Enhancements: Improved the visuals of certain scenes.
4.New Content: Added new adult content.

We will continue to update this month to fix known bugs and add support for more languages. More exciting content is planned for release next month.
